# BPM improvements

Branch: `bpm-improvements`. Baseline: Mixxx **2.7.0-alpha**,
commit `0fffd3d0d07b755c34c1730f7b87afadd8f2be19`.

## Central changes

| Area | Main edits / functions | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tempo modes | `BeatGridMode`, `BeatDetectionSettings`, preferences and reanalysis menu | Auto, Constant and Variable modes, including per-track choices and migration of existing settings. |
| Grid selection | `BeatFactory::makePreferredBeats()` | Separates sustained drift from abrupt tracker phase changes; Constant fits a full-track grid. |
| Audio clock | `recoverBeatClock()`, `BeatGridEvidence::recoverGrid()` | Selects a supported tempo family across the track and reconstructs shared drift from independent frequency bands. Applies to all three modes. |
| Kick alignment | `evaluate()`, `findAttack()`, `refineAttackShift()` | Confirms half-beat corrections across both track halves; aligns fine timing to kick attacks while protecting against offbeat kicks and earlier hi-hats. |
| Queen Mary refinement | `refineBeatTrackingTempo()` | Supplies the initial beat sequence and corrects supported metrical errors before audio-clock recovery. |
| BPM display and editing | `getBpmInRange()`, `tryScale()`, `tryTranslateBeats()`, `trySetBpm()` | Steadier BPM readings; fractional factors, phase shifts and BPM edits preserve variable tempo. Locked grids remain protected. |
| Analysis and caching | `AnalyzerBeats` | Preserves protected grids, handles partial final blocks, and versions analysis results. Fast analysis applies to Constant mode. |
| Waveform transport | `VisualPlayPosition::getPlaySlipAtNextVSync()` | Searches the complete position history at higher output latency. A bounded fallback keeps the waveform moving while the history fills. |
| Linux installation | `install-linux.sh`, `tools/install-linux.py` | User-local build/install workflow, dedicated profile and starter, safe updates and RAM-aware parallelism. |

## Tests

| Version | Environment | Passed tests |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Unchanged baseline | Debian 13 | 1,265 |
| Initial port (`c85a8ae16b`) | Debian 13 | 1,330 |
| Attack correction (`9aaf9881e9`) | Ubuntu 24.04 container | 1,340 |
| Audio-clock recovery and variable-grid editing | Ubuntu 24.04 container | 1,376 |
| Waveform transport fix | Ubuntu 24.04 container | 1,387 |

Application and test builds succeeded. The latest total combines 1,386 CTest
cases and one file test run from a writable directory. The 38 repository-disabled
tests remain disabled; the optional external-material test adds one more disabled
entry and was run separately. Use CTest's separate processes to avoid existing
shared-state conflicts in a single full-suite process.

Coverage includes:

- **24 baseline comparison cases:** identical 64-second stereo signals for Queen
  Mary and SoundTouch in Constant/Variable modes; 80/120/174 BPM, accents, 48 kHz
  input and gradual tempo drift.
- **Grid and lifecycle regressions:** mode selection/migration, phase and metrical
  changes, breakbeats, fractional tempos, malformed sequences, silence,
  reinitialization, protected grids, fast-analysis boundaries, preferences and
  cache behavior. Both QML startup smoke tests pass.
- **Attack regressions:** aligned/early/late grids, weak spikes before loud bass
  bodies, preceding hi-hats with sustained bass, 44.1/48 kHz, two chunk sizes and
  complete Auto/Constant analysis. Timing tolerance: 3 ms per tested beat.
- **36 new regressions:** 17 audio-clock cases, four recovery/phase pipeline
  cases, four clock-fit cases and 11 variable-grid editing/serialization cases.
  Cover sparse offbeat kicks, missing pulses, silence, independent band offsets,
  small coherent drift, fractional factors and BPM locks.
- **11 waveform regressions:** delayed audio output, short history, seek,
  pause/play, reverse, slip, loops and invalidation. Two renderer cases reproduce
  the frozen-at-start display before the fix and pass afterward, including beat
  analysis updates. Beat-analysis code and existing grid data are unchanged.

### Initial port comparison

The following results describe the initial port, before the later attack
correction. Error is the mean distance to the nearest beat, excluding the first
and last four seconds. SoundTouch supplies BPM only; its implied grid phase is
not a beat-tracking quality measure.

| Analyzer / mode | Input | Baseline BPM | Port BPM | Baseline error (ms) | Port error (ms) |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Queen Mary / Variable | accented174 | 86.9900 | 86.9900 | 172.414 | 172.414 |
| Queen Mary / Variable | drifting120 | 117.9600 | 117.9600 | 6.166 | 6.166 |
| Queen Mary / Variable | steady120 | 120.0200 | 120.0200 | 12.494 | 12.494 |
| Queen Mary / Variable | steady120_48k | 120.0100 | 120.0100 | 11.443 | 11.443 |
| Queen Mary / Variable | steady174 | 87.0100 | 87.0100 | 172.377 | 172.377 |
| Queen Mary / Variable | steady80 | 80.0100 | 80.0100 | 10.592 | 10.592 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | accented174 | 87.0000 | 174.0000 | 172.414 | 6.190 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | drifting120 | 118.0000 | 117.8648 | 96.421 | 92.600 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | steady120 | 120.0000 | 120.0001 | 11.406 | 7.662 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | steady120_48k | 120.0000 | 120.0000 | 10.625 | 6.904 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | steady174 | 87.0000 | 174.0000 | 172.414 | 6.213 |
| Queen Mary / Constant | steady80 | 80.0000 | 80.0019 | 10.952 | 7.211 |

All 12 SoundTouch and six Queen Mary Variable measurements match the baseline.
The 174 BPM Constant cases improve from roughly 87 to 174 BPM. Forcing Constant
on drifting audio still gives about 93 ms error; Auto is tested separately.

### Attack correction

The complete analysis regression uses a short attack followed by a bass envelope
peaking 25 ms later. Both Auto and Constant pass with 500/4096-frame chunks.
Positive signed error means the grid is late.

| Sample rate | Previous mean signed error (ms) | Current mean signed error (ms) | Current maximum lateness (ms) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 44.1 kHz | +10.410 | +0.410 | 1.196 |
| 48 kHz | -4.559 | +0.441 | 0.488 |

The attack timing figures above use synthetic audio. The full-song measurements
below use decoded music; neither replaces a listening check on DJ hardware.

### Full-song validation

All 12 supplied recordings were analyzed completely in Auto, Constant and
Variable modes, before and after the changes (36 analyses per version). All
resulting grids are finite, increasing, within the recording and free of large
interval jumps. Production code contains no track names or track-specific rules.

| Recording | Auto BPM | Auto grid | Main result |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Born Slippy | 140.063 | Constant | Stable tempo and corrected half-beat phase. |
| Hell vs. Ritchie | 134.049 | Constant | Corrected half-beat phase. |
| Frozen Memories | 139.41 | Variable | Corrected 2:3 tempo; follows shared timing drift. |
| My Breakfast | 137.97 | Variable | Small smooth variation; changing kicks do not move the grid by half a beat. |
| Designer Music | 132.01 | Variable | Corrected half tempo. |
| Celtic Cross | 129.635 | Constant | Stable tempo and corrected half-beat phase. |
| Jack Me Off | 134.892 | Constant | Stable phase across changing kick patterns. |
| Gamma Player | 127.01 | Variable | Retains small, independently supported drift. |
| Tone Control | 139.66 | Variable | Corrected 2:3 tempo while retaining drift. |
| The Wire | 148.10 | Variable | Corrected 2:3 tempo while retaining drift. |
| The Oil Zone | 120.031 | Constant | Accurate full-track tempo removes drift and the late 160 BPM switch. |
| Face It | 145.09 | Variable | Follows the nonlinear timing changes without interval jumps. |

"Variable" follows coherent timing variation across bands, including small
variations in older recordings. It does not depend on the recording's name.
The Oil Zone's on/offbeat attack scores are close because of its arrangement;
the algorithm retains the initial phase rather than forcing an uncertain flip.

### Reproduction

For a build configured with `-DBUILD_TESTING=ON` (`build` below):

```sh
cmake --build build --parallel 4
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QT_QUICK_BACKEND=software
ctest --test-dir build --parallel 4 --output-on-failure
build/mixxx-test \
  '--gtest_filter=Backends/BeatAnalysisComparisonTest.*:BeatPhaseAlignmentTest.*:*BeatPhaseAnalyzerTest.*' \
  --gtest_output=xml:build/beat-comparison-current.xml
```

The optional `BeatMaterialTest.DISABLED_MeasuresExternalManifest` accepts a JSON
array of `{ "id": "label", "path": "/path/to/audio" }` through
`MIXXX_BEAT_MATERIAL_MANIFEST` and writes measurements to
`MIXXX_BEAT_MATERIAL_OUTPUT`. Run it with `--gtest_also_run_disabled_tests` and
the matching test filter. Audio files remain outside the repository.
